Shell + project marker + review decision plumbing + intakes are worth keeping. Home is a self-directed creator dashboard (wrong job). Inbox/library/notifications are fixtures. CLIENT_APP_DESIGN_STATUS=REFERENCE_LOCKED_V1 (shared/site00-client-app/designStatus.ts) is self-asserted against an untracked founder board; QA screenshots are not committed.
